name: Citizenship Reinstatement -- Pre-1940 Citizens and Descendants

qualifying_event.description: Applicant, or their parent/grandparent/great-grandparent, held citizenship of independent Lithuania before the 15 June 1940 Soviet occupation, under Article 9 of the Law on Citizenship.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Proof of ancestor's pre-15-June-1940 Lithuanian citizenship; documented lineage from that ancestor to the applicant.

requirement_groups.name: Descendant of a citizen of independent Lithuania before 15 June 1940

requirements.blocker_text: Applicant, or their parent/grandparent/great-grandparent, held citizenship of independent Lithuania before the 15 June 1940 Soviet occupation, under Article 9 of the Law on Citizenship.
No residence period, language exam, or Constitution exam is required under this route.
Citizenship cannot be reinstated under this route more than once.

evidence_required.document: Proof of ancestor's pre-15-June-1940 Lithuanian citizenship
Documented lineage from that ancestor to the applicant

sources.title: e-Seimas (Lithuania's official legislative database) -- Law on Citizenship, Article 9 (persons who were citizens of the Republic of Lithuania before 15 June 1940, and their descendants)

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Lithuania).
